i270 | - | kind:question layer:mapping cause:symbol-mapping cause:doc-gap outcome:docs-answer pr_potential:docs-fix conf:stated depth=full | BTN_BACK and BTN_FORWARD do nothing for browser navigation. Root: naming in input-event-codes.h is confusing; BTN_SIDE and BTN_EXTRA are what browsers actually use for back/forward. Docs gap: add a note that BTN_BACK/FORWARD may not work as expected.

i274 | - | kind:bug layer:daemon layer:device cause:autoload-failure cause:race-condition component:service de_os:ubuntu de_os:gnome device_type:mouse outcome:workaround pr_potential:needs-design conf:stated impact:broken-remap symptom:mapping-not-working depth=full | Logitech MX Anywhere 2 Bluetooth: autoload doesn't work after reboot on Ubuntu. Multiple reporters. Root: udev rule fires with empty DEVNAME for Bluetooth devices; service doesn't find device at the provided path. Workaround: delayed autostart via .desktop sleep. Maintainer noted TODOs: autoload without DEVNAME, retry device path lookup.

Race condition in keycode_mapper: macro object was replaced by a tuple during press handling. Fixed in PR #277.

Root: jonasBoss added `slots=True` to a dataclass which requires Python ≥3.10; Ubuntu ships 3.8. Fixed by removing the slots argument.

i282 | - | kind:bug layer:injector cause:de-compat cause:evdev-api component:injector de_os:gnome outcome:workaround pr_potential:upstream-dep conf:inferred impact:partial-remap symptom:mapping-not-working depth=full | Scroll events from mapped keys blocked by libinput when mouse cursor is moving simultaneously. Works in Firefox (GTK) but not in GNOME Shell apps (Qt/non-GTK). Root: libinput likely filters scroll events paired with pointer movement as accidental. Workaround: xdotool scroll or wrapping the mapping via xdotool.
